class.name: OcgImeshdataEdge
class.brief_description: Interface class representing discrete model of an edge.
class.description: ! Interface class representing discrete model of an edge.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears curve and all pcurves assigned to the edge from discretization.

method.name: IsFree
method.description: Returns true in case if the edge is free one, i.e. it does not have pcurves.

method.name: GetAngularDeflection
method.description: Gets value of angular deflection for the discrete model.

method.name: SetAngularDeflection
method.description: Sets value of angular deflection for the discrete model.

method.name: GetSameParam
method.description: Returns same param flag. By default equals to flag stored in topological shape.

method.name: GetSameRange
method.description: Returns same range flag. By default equals to flag stored in topological shape.

method.name: GetDegenerated
method.description: Returns degenerative flag. By default equals to flag stored in topological shape.
